companyDescription: Custom AI ASIC · Google TPU + Apple + Meta + OpenAI 'Jalapeño' silicon design · VMware software + networking moats
priceNote: Down 24% from $495 ATH after Q2 miss — 48 analysts still Strong Buy, avg target $523
summary: Broadcom is the dominant custom AI ASIC designer for Google (TPU), Apple, Meta, and now OpenAI ('Jalapeño' chip). After a -15% post-Q2 drop on no guidance raise, AVGO trades 24% below ATH at a historically attractive re-entry zone. 48 analysts rate Strong Buy with avg target $523 (+39%). Q3 earnings Sep 3 is the next major catalyst — a guidance raise on the $100B AI revenue target would sharply reprice the stock.

catalysts.description: Google diversifying TPU design to MediaTek. AVGO's share projected 95%→65% by 2028. 5-year contract through 2031 still intact — AVGO holds highest-margin training workloads.

risks: Google TPU market share erosion: 95% → ~65% by 2028 as MediaTek gains supplier share

Q2 FY2026 revenue miss ($22.19B vs $22.27B est) + no $100B AI guidance raise — high bar for Q3
Premium valuation at P/E 61.99 — vulnerable to Fed rate surprises or macro slowdown
Semiconductor sector at 19.7% of S&P 500 — crowded, outsized selloff risk on macro shock
